vulnerability_title: H-1: Gas consumed in `notifyUnsubscribe` is underestimated during tests and is greater than 300,000 without pre-warming

recommendation.recommendation_text: Further gas optimisations must be made to `notifyUnsubscribe` not to hit the limit. A radical change could be to only set a flag "pendingUnsubscribe" on the given position in both the daily gauge and the incentive gauge, to make it ineligible for claiming at first. Then the heavy work of unsubscribing and cleaning accounting data can be done during a subsequent call outside of the critical path.
